prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["One Account Keeps Your Pets Safe", "Sign in with your main email or social account to keep your pet saved to your profile and easily accessible anywhere."]
2: ["Give Your Pet a Name & Personality", "Name your companion and select their desktop behavior style before completing adoption.", "Continue to Certificate"]
3: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide or chat, and click and drag to move them around your screen."]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Journey"]
5: ["Verifying Desktop Pet Workspace", "Checking screen coordinates and rendering environment before spawning your pet."]
6: ["Complete Adoption & Claim Founder Badge", "Finalize your adoption certificate to unlock the Founder Pet Badge for your desktop companion.", "Founder Pet Badge"]
7: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile", "Connect your account in one click to sync and protect your pet."]
8: ["Adopt Immediately or Craft a Custom Pet", "Pick a ready companion to launch instantly on your desktop, or customize your own pet step by step."]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or promotional rewards (Founder Badge)
